execution: decide at close, fill at next open, long-only, no leverage
hypothesis: Gold and silver share monetary demand but their relative prices sometimes diverge. A trailing gold/silver ETF-price ratio may identify the temporarily cheaper metal; holding only that metal during extreme deviations tests relative-value mean reversion.
rules: At each daily close compute GLD close / SLV close and its trailing 60-bar z-score, including the current close; population standard deviation.
If z >= 2 hold SLV; if z <= -2 hold GLD; otherwise hold cash. No hysteresis or minimum holding period.
Allocate 100 percent to the selected ETF, with no shorts or leverage; missing/zero dispersion means cash.
Decide at the close and fill at the next open. ETF-price ratio is a proxy, not an ounce-price ratio or a hedged pair trade.
